purpose: Each case plants exactly one semantically impossible value using the CORRECT canonical field name. Cases are keyed to PRD acceptance criteria. Authored independently of the implementation.

base_payload.Description: Purchased electricity for the main venue.
base_payload.Name: Venue electricity, September 2026

cases.name: negative quantity
cases.model_basis: Quantity is numeric; a negative mass of emissions is physically impossible. Model declares constraints:null, which is why this is currently missed.
cases.blocked_by: Q2 — confirm which fields permit negatives

cases.name: invalid unit, canonical key
cases.note: CONTROL CASE. Already passes. Proves the constraint is reachable when the key is canonical — contrast with M-CTRL.

cases.name: inverted validity period
cases.model_basis: Fields form a validity pair via naming convention; start must not follow end. No cross-field constraint is expressible in the current model, so this must be implemented in the validator.

cases.name: malformed start datetime
cases.model_basis: MODEL DEFECT (openfootprint#48): Valid From Datetime declares constraints:null while its required partner Valid To Datetime declares format:date-time. The validator must not inherit this asymmetry.

cases.name: malformed end datetime
cases.note: CONTROL CASE. Already passes. Its pairing with E4 isolates the model asymmetry as the sole cause of the E4 miss.

cases.name: invalid enum member
cases.model_basis: Reference-data FK. Pattern passes, but the referent is not a member of the reference set. Requires membership checking beyond regex.
cases.note: Distinguishes pattern conformance from referent validity.

cases.name: deprecated field in use
cases.model_basis: Field description begins 'DEPRECATED'. Four such fields exist on this entity.

cases.name: zero quantity is legitimate
cases.model_basis: NEGATIVE TEST. Zero emissions is a valid measurement. Must not be swept up by the value_range check.

cases.name: canonical payload is clean
cases.model_basis: NEGATIVE TEST. Baseline payload uses only canonical field names and satisfies every declared constraint.
